messages:
laura: Heads-up team — planning a small experiment on the pricing page this evening. Scope: tighten a couple FAQ lines, rename one tier label, and change calculator -> lead routing for enterprise picks. Quick review appreciated.

jamie: What's the hypothesis we're testing?

laura: Hypothesis: clearer language around reserved vs metered reduces inbound questions and nudges more signups to the reserved flow. Also aim to shave SLA by routing enterprise-calculator leads directly to AE queue.

raj: Paste the exact copy changes so I can include them in the launch post.

laura: Copy drafts: 
- FAQ: "Reserved capacity (previously called 'Committed') — monthly GPU commitment that guarantees throughput and predictable pricing."
- Price card label: show as "Reserved" with full explainer on hover: "Reserved capacity: monthly GPU commitment for guaranteed throughput and predictable cost."

ben: Slight worry that 'Reserved' could be misread as 'unavailable'. Could we use 'Reserved capacity' on cards and shorten elsewhere?

tess: UX: keep tooltip to one sentence. Proposed tooltip above is fine. Also confirm accessible aria labels for the tooltip.

laura: Good call on aria labels — ops, add to QA checklist.

laura: Routing snippet for staging (estimator -> lead router):
```
# estimator -> lead routing (staging)
if estimator.output.segment == 'enterprise':
  lead_queue = 'AE_high_touch'
elif estimator.output.annual_commitment >= 10000:
  lead_queue = 'AE_medium'
else:
  lead_queue = 'SDR_inbound'
```

ops-bot: lead-router: mapping updated on staging at 2026-03-22T05:12:04Z  rule-id LR-20260322-11

marcus: Can we run an A/B test (50/50) — new wording vs current? Tag experiment pricing-copy-q2 and use a 14-day window.

jamie: :thumbsup: Tracking: support ticket volume, commit CTA clickthrough, calculator completion rate.

ben: I'll set up the estimator funnel heatmap and seed the experiment with sample customer profiles for QA.

raj: Drafting the launch post now with hypothesis and links to dashboards. Anyone want to review before I publish?

tess: I'll skim after lunch and check accessibility notes.

laura: Thanks. If no objections by EOD we'll flip the flag to canary. Ping @ben if you need dashboard help.

jamie: Tiny wording suggestion: change "previously called 'Committed'" -> "previously 'Committed'" for concision.

laura: Updated in the doc. Notion link: https://redwoodhq.notion/pricing/clarity-experiment-2026

ops-bot: deploy-bot: experiment flag pricing-copy-q2 enabled in prod canary at 2026-03-22T05:45:10Z

marcus: Capturing baseline metrics now; will post a summary in #marketing-reporting by Friday.

laura: Will post final notes in this thread after 48h. :rocket:
